about_the_game:
The animals of the kingdom have all turned grumpy—and it's up to you to bring back the joy, one tune at a time!

In this twist on the survivors-like genre, you’ll assemble a band of music-playing animals and roam areas filled with quests, secrets, and sour-faced critters in need of cheering up.

Every Run Sounds Different

Choose your bandmates wisely! Each animal brings their own musical part to the mix, and together, they form a unique procedurally generated soundtrack that evolves as you play. No two runs sound the same.

Form Your Dream Band

Recruit from a growing roster of adorable animals—each with their own instruments, personalities, and musical styles. Mix and match to discover new sounds.

Explore a Charming World

Wander through forests, hills, and villages as you help characters, unlock new regions and find new bandmates.

Making Friends

Whether you're looking to vibe with dynamic tunes, discover quirky characters, or simply enjoy a cozy and creative adventure, this game invites you to tune in, team up, and turn the grumpiness around.

short_description: Assemble a band of music-playing animals and roam the land to help grumpy creatures rediscover their joy. Each run features unique, procedurally generated music based on the bandmates you choose, as you complete quests and meet quirky characters along the way.
